statement: The pinned Linux hid-playstation and SDL PS4 HID output implementations do not provide the physical DualShock 4 USB Audio Class descriptor set. For the reviewed sources, UAC revision, supported PCM sample rates, physical output and capture channel allocation, audio terminal types, feature-unit mute or volume controls, and isochronous endpoint packet limits remain unknown. This does not establish that a physical DS4 lacks USB audio.

applicability.scope: Physical USB audio-descriptor gap from the inspected Linux HID and SDL PS4 consumer implementations; neither enumerates class-specific sound descriptors.
